implementation.sourceTracing: Pinned Pi Bedrock constructs BedrockRuntimeClient with profile/region/explicit endpoint/proxy and key trio, no custom signer/endpoint provider. INI static credentials/fromEnv can add credentialScope to a credential object, but Bedrock ConverseStream uses empty command-specific endpoint parameters plus common Endpoint/Region/UseDualStack/UseFIPS only; its decision diagram never requests CredentialScope. The generic Smithy config value provider reads credentialScope only when an endpoint parameter asks for it. Bedrock resolveAwsSdkSigV4Config selects ordinary SignatureV4; its signing scope is constructed from date/region/service/aws4_request and the derivation reads key/secret/session, not credentialScope. Thus an ignored field cannot justify a new SigV4a implementation or rejection of an otherwise usable INI/Environment source. This is bounded source tracing, not execution of a reference SDK or a claim about all AWS services.
